text:
In eighteen ninety-one, the Kinetograph made pictures move. ...

Until now, video from code meant a browser, screenshotting every single frame. ...

Kinetograph doesn't need one. ...

It renders straight on the GPU. ...

Your demo. ... Your launch. ... Your changelog. ...

Write it in code, and it renders. ...

And not just text. ...

Real three D. ...

Isometric scenes. ...

Shaders. ...

Canvas. ...

Even glass that bends the light. ...

Already using Remotion? ... Kinetograph is a drop-in replacement. ...

This whole film rendered in twenty-six seconds. ...

No Chromium. ... No screenshots. ... Just pixels. ...

Kinetograph. ...

Motion pictures, written in code. ...

Try it at kinetograph dot dev.
